# swarmbus
> Cross-process lease and claim table in a shared mmap file (layout v2: hash-placed slots, per-slot seqlock, 64-bit fencing), plus an in-process blackboard and compute-budget auction, in Zig 0.16. Read-only Python and Rust clients.

- `swarmbus lease|release|claim|read <shm_path> ...`: leases with fencing tokens and last-writer-wins claims; keys 1-64 bytes, values <= 192 bytes.
- `swarmbus auction ...`: greedy compute-budget auction (utility per token).
- `swarmbus bench`: in-process, shared-memory and cross-process round trip (~0.4-0.8 us with both processes spinning, M2 Max).
- `python/swarmbus.py`: seqlock reads; writes via the binary. `rust/`: read-only client.

README.md is the source of truth, including measured numbers with hardware and commit.
